description: Source code for the SlashCommandService in the Mattermost plugin API, providing methods to manage slash commands such as register, unregister, execute, list, get, update, and delete commands.

classes.name: SlashCommandService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to manipulate slash commands in Mattermost.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered slash command.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a server-owned slash command that persists beyond plugin lifecycle.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Returns all slash commands for a team.

methods.name: ListCustom
methods.description: Returns custom slash commands created through the integrations menu, REST API, or plugin API.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a command definition by command ID.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates a slash command with new information.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a slash command by command ID.
